modelspec.observatory.RunStarted.title: RunStarted
modelspec.observatory.RunStarted.description: The event of a run starting, the first of its stream (RunEventBody). It carries the two TrainingRun fields that say which steps follow, start_step through start_step + steps (DESIGN.md § 6); the other record fields are the run's artifact and record, which M0 does not write (story:m0-cpu-sgd-training, Out of scope).

steps.description: TrainingRun.steps, the steps of this invocation.

start_step.description: TrainingRun.start_step, the step of the first StepCompleted.
